summary.text: One of the twenty-three suitors from Same on Cephallenia in Apollodorus' catalogue — a namesake of the Ithacus who with Neritus and Polyctor built the town fountain in Homer's Odyssey.

story.text: Apollodorus names Ithacus among the wooers assigned to Same, listed after Archemolus and before Pisenor in Epitome 7.28.
Homer knows another Ithacus — not this suitor — as one of three who made the fair-flowing fountain outside the city of Ithaca, with Neritus and Polyctor; the Epitome name is a homonym hazard only.
